metadata.title: Retro R&B Album Cover Aesthetic
useCases: Promotional posters with a moody urban vibe

retrievalProfile.description: A moody, urban noir composition featuring a mirrored portrait against venetian blinds with heavy horizontal emphasis and bold, extended typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A vertically mirrored close-up of a face, partially obscured by a black lace-gloved hand, set against a background of dark horizontal venetian blinds. The composition is anchored by bold, wide-set typography in the corners and a circular sticker element.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetrical vertical reflection of the subject
Horizontal rhythm established by background blinds
Contrast between organic lace textures and rigid geometric lines
Typographic weight balancing the dark photographic masses
coreInvariants: Mirrored facial reflection along a central horizontal axis
Black lace texture overlaying the central subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Extreme close-up of a face mirrored across the horizontal center, filling the left two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The black lace-gloved hand positioned at the center-right, acting as the bridge between the mirrored halves.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the top-right bold text, down the vertical reflection, to the bottom-right inverted text, following the mirrored symmetry.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, shadowed areas between the slats of the blinds and the deep shadows of the hair.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep shadows and dark browns/blacks in the photography.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm skin tones and muted beige of the blinds.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red for the primary display text and stark white for the sticker element.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low-key lighting with high value contrast in the typography and sticker.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Inverted orientation for bottom-right text block
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Monospace-adjacent extended sans-serifs used in contrasting colors and orientations.
graphicDevices: Circular white sticker with black sans-serif text
Small rectangular logo block in bottom left corner

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the 80s tech-urban aesthetic and extreme width.
Provides the necessary geometric squareness and horizontal presence.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-key photograph of a person's face mirrored vertically across the center. The person wears a black lace glove. The background consists of dark horizontal venetian blinds with light filtering through the slats.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, horizontally stretched red sans-serif title in the top right. Add a white circular sticker with black text in the upper left. Add an inverted white stretched sans-serif title in the bottom right.

verificationChecks: Is the bottom text block inverted (upside down)?
Is the background composed of horizontal blinds?
Is the central image mirrored vertically?

adjustableVariables: Degree of horizontal stretch in typography
Saturation of the red accent color
mustRedesign: Do not use specific artist names or album titles
Do not replicate the specific record label logo
Ensure the face is a generic representation
postGenerationChecks: Verify the red text is in the top right corner
Ensure the circular sticker is present in the upper left quadrant
Confirm the bottom text is inverted and white
Check that the background blinds are strictly horizontal
recipe.reuseFormula: Mirrored Portrait + Venetian Blinds + Extended Sans-Serif Typography
